Class WaitingRoomAfterCrashState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.WaitingRoomAfterCrashState
public class WaitingRoomAfterCrashState extends GameState
State implementation that manages fault tolerance and session recovery immediately following a server crash or massive network failure.

This class acts as a synchronized staging environment (Waiting Room). When a game is reloaded from a persistent save state, control is assigned here until all original participants successfully establish a new connection. Upon complete reconnection, the state executes a crucial structural re-linking routine: it synchronizes volatile network player references with stale structural placements inside the board layouts (such as TurnOrderCard and OffersPath) before safely rolling back control to the game state active right before the crash occurred.

  • Method Details

    • onPlayerConnection

      protected void onPlayerConnection(Game game, String nickname, String totemColor)
      Handles the physical reconnection event of a player returning to the recovered game environment.

      The processing lifecycle carries out the following steps:

      1. Broadcasts a PlayerReconnectedEvent notification to push current board layouts and historical models down to the newly connected view client.
      2. Increments the internal connection counter via addNumPlayersConnected().
      3. Checks if the quorum of reconnected users matches the original game size setup (game.getNumPlayers()).
      4. If the quorum is reached, it initiates a defensive dual-pass mapping sweep to overwrite stale player references with new session tokens within the TurnOrderCard sequence and the grid-mapped OffersPath track slots.
      5. Advances the state machine using nextState(Game) and fires a global GameRestartedEvent to inform all participants that structural setup has stabilized and active turns are resuming.
      Overrides:
      onPlayerConnection in class GameState
      Parameters:
      game - the central Game context manager directing recovery routines
      nickname - the unique textual signature profile of the returning user
      totemColor - the aesthetic identifier mapped to the player's game token
